templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA standard terms, letting two parties share confidential information with each other to evaluate or pursue a business relationship.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, governing law and signatures; it incorporates the Mutual NDA standard terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement covering target uptime, response times and service credits; designed to be used with the Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) setting out how a provider processes customer personal data, including processor and subprocessor obligations under data protection laws.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving an early partner access to a product in exchange for feedback during development.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for services and deliverables provided under statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, with terms for payment, trademark licensing and escalation.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing how a provider uses and protects PHI under HIPAA.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement, a short-term contract that lets a prospective customer trial or evaluate a product before committing to a longer-term deal.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum that supplements a commercial agreement with terms for AI services, including use of inputs and outputs and model training.
